context: With the deprecation of LegacyChat, games that haven't yet complied with the necessary chat service requirements have started being auto-migrated to run TextChatService instead of LegacyChatService. In addition to emails and forum posts that have already been sent, we'd like to include a warning message in the Output Window of Studio to let dev's know their experience has been auto-migrated.
source: Your experience has been auto-migrated and will now use TextChatService at runtime.

values.en-us: Your experience has been auto-migrated and will now use TextChatService at runtime.
